name: Resting Sycamore Acronym Decoder for Medicare Terms
author: restingsycamoremedicare

sections.description:
Resting Sycamore Acronym Decoder for Medicare Terms adds a searchable glossary for Medicare terms to a WordPress page or post.

Visitors can search common Medicare acronyms and terms, see plain-English explanations, and read a short note on why each term matters.

The glossary runs in the visitor’s browser using local plugin files. It does not add analytics, cookies, tracking, accounts, forms, remote data calls, or personal data collection.

This plugin is for general Medicare education. It does not recommend Medicare plans, determine eligibility, ask for personal information, or compare benefits.

The plugin is maintained by Resting Sycamore.

Shortcode

Basic use:

[resting_sycamore_acronym_decoder]

Hide the brand header:

[resting_sycamore_acronym_decoder show_brand="false"]

Hide resource links:

[resting_sycamore_acronym_decoder show_resources="false"]

Change the heading:

[resting_sycamore_acronym_decoder title="Medicare Terms Explained"]<h3>Privacy</h3>

This plugin does not add analytics, cookies, tracking pixels, account creation, forms, remote data calls, or personal data collection.

Compliance Note

Educational only. Not connected with or endorsed by the U.S. government or the federal Medicare program.

Definitions should be reviewed through the normal Resting Sycamore Medicare compliance workflow before public use.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the resting-sycamore-acronym-decoder folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the ZIP file through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Add the shortcode [resting_sycamore_acronym_decoder] to a page or post.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin collect personal information?

No. The plugin uses a local glossary file and local JavaScript. Searches stay in the visitor’s browser.

Does this plugin recommend Medicare plans?

No. The glossary is educational only. It does not compare plans, determine eligibility, or recommend coverage.

Can I use more than one decoder on the same page?

Yes. Each shortcode instance gets its own search field and result area.

Where can I update the glossary terms?

The term data is in assets/terms.js. Review any changes through your normal Medicare compliance process before publishing.
